worldPlate: A world-bible establishing plate for Operation Magpie: a modern European city at night, seen as a set of glamorous and grubby INTERIORS rather than a skyline. Pack the palette and materials into one frame — wet black tarmac and brass, oxblood leather, cut crystal and cigarette smoke, green baize, tarnished gilt, polished walnut, cold white marble, brushed steel. Deep blue-black shadow with warm sodium and amber pools; a single cold accent of neon. Painterly, cinematic, film grain, high contrast. TIME-NEUTRAL — soft even light, neither dusk nor dawn, so each room's own prompt drives the hour. No people, no lettering, no captions, no text.
